headline: EDB Acquires Altinity to Expand Open Source Database Capabilities
summary: EnterpriseDB (EDB) has acquired Altinity to integrate Postgres and ClickHouse expertise. The merger aims to create a multi-model data system supporting transactions, analytics, and AI.
why: EDB is a provider of enterprise-grade database software based on PostgreSQL. Acquisitions in the database and AI infrastructure space are common as companies seek to consolidate data management tools.

impacts.name: EnterpriseDB
impacts.why: The acquisition expands the company's product portfolio in the database and AI sector.
